messages:
leo (AE): Heads up team, Aurora (regulated payments startup) asked for a tight capacity & pricing recommendation for their POC. Traffic profile: baseline ~120 RPS, short peaks up to ~480 RPS for 10-20 minutes, average prompt 1.5k tokens + completion ~6k tokens (avg ~7.5k/request). They asked for reserved vs burst cost comparison, VPC peering, and KMS.
tanya (Solutions): Thanks. Couple clarifiers before we size: are peaks concurrent interactive users or async batch? Do they need strict p99 tail SLA?
leo (AE): Interactive spikes, web-chat style. They want p95 SLO ~1s and p99 < 3.5s if possible, but will accept carveouts for very large completions.
kevin (Infra): Quick math: avg 7.5k tokens/request. 480 RPS -> 3.6M tokens/sec. With optimized batching + kv-cache we can reduce work per request significantly for session-based prompts. H100-80GB throughput for q4_0-13B-int8 is roughly 18-22k tokens/sec per GPU in our infra tests (when well-batched). That suggests ~180 GPUs naive, but with session KV caching and partial prefix reuse we can cut effective token load by 4-6x. Realistic plan: reserve baseline for baseline RPS and autoscale for bursts. Recommend model options: 13B-int8 (preferred) or 7B-highthroughput for fallback.
beau (SRE): Proposed sizing: baseline reserved pool = 6 x H100-80GB (handles ~100-140 RPS steady with q4-13B + batching). Autoscale policy to add nodes quickly to handle spikes up to 20 GPUs total. Prewarm=3 nodes before routing shift, warm KV cache primed for active sessions. Autoscale params I'd share with customer: min_gpus=6, max_gpus=20, scale_up_step=4, scale_down_step=2, scale_cooldown=45s, prewarm_count=3.
noah (Pricing): For headline numbers I'll need expected GPU-hours at baseline and spike patterns. As a placeholder: 6 reserved H100s ~ $YYYk/mo, bursting to 20 with on-demand could add heavy token charges. We can offer a blended reserved+burst plan: commit to 6 reserved and cap monthly burst hours; offer 15% discount on reserved and 10 preheat credits. I'll put concrete $ after infra perf runs.
sec-bot: Security quick-check: VPC peering OK for Private or Dedicated. Customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployment. Audit logs (request-level) available; retention can be extended to 90d for enterprise. Recommend Private deployment for payments workloads.
tanya (Solutions): Operational notes: add a fallback route to 7B-quantized pool if latency SLO broken or if memory errors occur. Also add model-hedging rule: if p95 > threshold for 3m, route new sessions to smaller model plus sampling on small percent to large model for quality monitoring.
kevin (Infra): Sample autoscale JSON to share (small differences from our defaults):
```
{
  "autoscale": {
    "min_gpus": 6,
    "max_gpus": 20,
    "scale_up_step": 4,
    "scale_down_step": 2,
    "cooldown_seconds": 45,
    "prewarm_nodes": 3,
    "routing_policy": "latency_then_cost"
  }
}
```
Also include warmup hook to prepopulate KV for top 300 active sessions and a health-check for KV hit ratio before cutover.
beau (SRE): Failure modes & mitigations: if autoscale lags due to cloud quota, fallback to queueing with soft-degradation messages and route to smaller model. If KV warm fails, allow degraded responses but maintain availability using stateless decoding on smaller models. We'll prepare an SRE runbook with steps and runbook IDs.
leo (AE): Customer asked about canary/rollback semantics and how quickly we can fail-over across regions. They want a 2-region plan for DR.
tanya (Solutions): We can do canary traffic with 5% initial traffic, 30m observation window, automatic rollback on error rate >2% or p95 increase >20%. Regional failover: warm a cold standby in eu-central with minimal reserved nodes (2 GPUs) and autoscale as needed; failover time target ~2-3 minutes for DNS/edge switch with warmed KV best-effort.
noah (Pricing): I'll prepare two cost lines: Hosted Dedicated (reserved 6 + burst to 20) and Private (same topology + infra surcharge and KMS/audit). Add-ons: extended log retention, 24/7 support, DR standby. Expect preliminary numbers by EOD tomorrow.
perf-bot: Perf job scheduled: sim-aurora-traffic -> cluster-staging at 2026-04-02T03:00Z (triggered by tanya). Collecting latency CSV and gpu_util traces.
leo (AE): Action list: kevin/tanya validate perf at 6/12/20 GPUs with q4-13B-int8 and 7B fallback; beau draft SRE runbook and chaos checklist; noah produce pricing draft; sec-bot attach KMS/SOC2 blurb. I'll send Aurora the two-option POC plan once we have perf numbers.
kevin (Infra): I'll run bench and publish token/sec and p50/p95/p99 CSVs. Also will include q3-int8 run to show cost vs latency tradeoff.
beau (SRE): I'll include chaos scenarios: quota exhaustion, prewarm fail, noisy neighbor, KV cold start, and expected mitigation steps.
leo (AE): Great, please ping when docs are ready. Meeting with Aurora infra on Friday 10am PT to walk plan.
noah (Pricing): On it, will share preliminary spreadsheet before EOD tomorrow.
